task_group.title: Strengthen “unit tests are mandatory” in the generated CodeSpec

metadata.primary_goal: Ensure the generated CodeSpecArtifact makes comprehensive unit testing mandatory, explicit, verifiable, and aligned to the 1–3 headline AI demo items (no extra plumbing acceptance criteria).
metadata.scope_mode: Option A (keep 3 phases; schema+prompt enforcement; minimal supporting logic)

context_summary.what_this_system_is: X-to-Demo generates feature_spec → demo_spec → code_spec artifacts for a downstream demo app (not the studio UI).

non_goals.item: Do not implement the demo app itself.
Do not add new pipeline phases.
Do not introduce platform plumbing (auth, billing, observability, etc.) unless explicitly required by proposal.

hard_principles.item: AI/technical innovation must be the first-class citizen.
Demo scope is limited to 1–3 headline items.
Outputs must be web browser compatible; smartphone-framed only if mobile app is indicated.
Dark/light system theme support is required.
At least one OpenAI API choice must appear in code spec (Responses, Realtime, and/or Agents SDK).
Tools only if absolutely necessary; if used: synthetic data + UI-visible tool call/result log.
Walkthrough is an in-app interactive UI tour (auto-start + retrigger + cancel), not a presenter script.
Unit tests must be comprehensive and run continuously during build.

inputs.repo_root_hint: Use existing repo structure; modify only the files needed.
inputs.task_list_authority: Implement Task Group D exactly: strengthen “unit tests are mandatory” in generated CodeSpec via schema + prompt updates.
inputs.conversation_context_authority: If unclear, follow the project constraints: AI-first, minimalism, avoid plumbing, stack-flexible specs, interactive walkthrough, OpenAI API selection, synthetic-only tools, and strict schema compliance.

file.reason: Schema: make test requirements explicit, comprehensive, and required.
Prompting: enforce generation of the new required test content; anti-drift reminders.

schema_changes.requirement: Add or strengthen a required section (preferred: ) that makes unit testing mandatory and specific.

required_fields.field: Must explicitly require: (a) comprehensive unit tests, (b) tests written alongside implementation, (c) tests executed continuously during build (e.g., after each major increment), (d) failing tests block completion.

Must enumerate test coverage per major module area, at minimum: - AI request/response handling (structured outputs parsing + validation) - guardrails short-circuit behavior - state transitions for core flows - walkthrough step mapping/highlight targeting - tool mocking if tools exist (otherwise state “no tools”)
Must state acceptance coverage is limited to the 1–3 headline demo items; must forbid adding acceptance criteria for excluded plumbing.

Must specify how to mock: - OpenAI API calls (Responses/Realtime/Agents as selected) - any tools (synthetic data based) Must include guidance for deterministic test fixtures and snapshot expectations where appropriate.

Must include a verifiable checklist for the coding agent, e.g.: - commands to run tests, - expected pass condition, - minimal test count/coverage expectations (qualitative, not tied to CI infrastructure).

schema_quality_constraints.item: Keep the schema stack-flexible (no framework mandates); describe constraints, not prescriptions.
Do not introduce unrelated new top-level fields unless necessary for the testing mandate.
Maintain strict structured output compatibility (no additionalProperties leakage; required fields enforced).

prompt_changes.requirement: Strengthen instructions to ensure every Phase 3 CodeSpec includes the required testing content and that it is not vague.

must_include.item: A dedicated testing strategy section matching the schema: plan per module + mocks + continuous test execution requirement.
Explicit statement that tests are written alongside implementation and run repeatedly during build.
Test scope limited to headline demo items; no plumbing acceptance criteria.

anti_drift.item: Output must match schema exactly; do not add fields.
No “we should test things” vagueness—must list concrete test targets and mocking approach.

step_by_step_plan.step: Open apps/api/app/x_to_demo/schemas/code_spec.py and locate the existing CodeSpecArtifact testing-related fields (if any).
Implement schema updates: - introduce/strengthen as required, - add required subfields listed above, - ensure they are described in an implementation-ready way without choosing a specific stack.
Ensure strict structured output compatibility: - additionalProperties false where appropriate, - required lists include the new required fields, - avoid schema constructs that break strict mode.

Update apps/api/app/x_to_demo/pipeline/prompts.py: - add explicit Phase 3 test mandate language, - include a short, forceful checklist for tests, - add anti-drift reminders (no extra fields; no plumbing).
Sanity check: - schema validates a sample CodeSpec output containing the required testing content, - prompts clearly force inclusion of the new fields.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CodeSpec schema requires a comprehensive testing strategy and cannot validate without it.

Testing strategy includes: per-module test plan, continuous test execution requirement, acceptance-scope limitation to headline items, and explicit mocking instructions for OpenAI + tools (if present).
Prompting changes reliably produce the new required testing fields and discourage vague or drifting outputs.
No new plumbing-related acceptance criteria are introduced; scope remains 1–3 headline demo items only.

deliverables.item: PR-ready edits to the specified files with minimal churn.
Optional: a small example snippet (in comments or internal notes) showing what the testing_strategy section should look like.

do_not.item: Do not expand scope into implementing the demo app.
Do not add new phases or unrelated “quality gate” systems beyond schema/prompt enforcement.
Do not prescribe a specific test runner/framework; describe requirements in stack-flexible terms.
Do not add external tools or dependencies unless already present and required.
